subject: Your Account Will Be Blocked
body: Dear customer, your account will be closed. Click here to update immediately.
explanation: Banks never send emails from Gmail addresses.

subject: Reward: ₹500 Amazon Gift Card
body: Congratulations! You've won a gift card. Claim now.
explanation: Amazon never gives random rewards without login verification.

subject: New Login to Your Account
body: A new login was detected to your account. If this was you, ignore.
explanation: This is a typical legitimate GitHub security email.

subject: Important: Update your contact details
body: Dear user, this is a security check. Please verify your contact.

subject: Password Expiring Soon
body: Your password expires in 48 hours. Reset it from the company portal.

subject: Your Paytm Needs Verification
body: Your Paytm KYC is incomplete. Click the link to update.
explanation: Fake domain: paytm-support.in is not official.

subject: Your Apple ID is Locked
body: We locked your Apple ID due to suspicious login. Verify immediately.
explanation: Apple never uses external domains like secure-auth.com.

subject: Suspicious Attempt Prevented
body: Google blocked a suspicious attempt. Check your account activity.

subject: Your Order Has an Issue
body: Your recent order is on hold. Click here to confirm.

subject: Delivery Issue: Confirm Your Address
body: We couldn’t verify your address. Update to continue delivery.
explanation: Swiggy sometimes sends such official alerts.

subject: Payment Failed
body: Your last payment failed. Update your card to keep watching.

subject: Statement Available
body: Your monthly statement is ready to download.
